notes.title: Game Walkthrough Part 3
notes.notes:
[b]Warriors and soldiers, grab your flashlights and follow us into that house of horrors once again! [/b]
Hope these tips will help you on your way. Look out, monsters are waiting for you!👻👻


[b]1.Haven't found anything in room 2-1? Look harder.[/b]🧐

Grab the grab rail next to the toilet and ....... Hey! Don't go, we're not done yet: don't forget the key to room 2-2 in the toilet.🔑
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/8d01392f2de6392ba95070c1cfee1e30c88aa82c.gif[/img]


[b]2. Feed my dog[/b]

Take the heart🫀 from the fridge in room 4 and feed it to the dog in room 2-2 to get to the key next to the dog safe and sound, otherwise you'll suffer the same fate as the poor heart.🤫
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/9000ab021f440ff1078af4a7eb1994f10ed0632a.gif[/img]


[b]3.Oh no, there's an ugly monster after me![/b]😱😱😭

Don't panic, use the tactic flashlight to buy yourself some time and then quickly find a hiding place such as a bed or wardrobe.
Be careful, the tactic flashlight is powerful but runs out of power quickly, so if you think you're safe for a while, I suggest you turn it off for now.🤔
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/0dd16aa49079474b4af9e1ce10368d756544ee53.gif[/img]


[b]4.I got rid of the monster, is it over now?[/b]

Of course not! Even though it’s scary, we should go back to room 3 to collect the black wire on the shelf. Before the monster finds you, open the wire cover on the floor and fix the electricity with the ones you  collected earlier.🧑‍🔧🔌
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121044/102d7c6d5ae5d3cdf8ac09461c19c3717b0d8de1.gif[/img]

[b]5.The final step[/b]

Congratulations!🎉🎉 The power has been restored, and now it's time to return to room 4 to operate the machine and face your fate!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/cd985e021278d1c74cbb10de9b6c9850f0ef9cae.gif[/img]


We hope you enjoy these mysteries and the excitement of running and hiding, all your ideas and suggestions are welcome.

[b]MORE HORROR EXPERIENCES ARE COMING![/b]✨✨

notes.title: Game Walkthrough Part 2
notes.notes:
[b]Hi, friends![/b]

Following up on the previous (Game Walkthrough Part 1), we’ve prepared a few more tips for you!



[b]1. Oh no! The flashlight is dead![/b]

Open the drawer! There’s a battery in here, quickly replace it! 🔦
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121044/a97aba58c051787bab6cdb3ce6b7bd15492c86b5.gif[/img]


[b]2. What secrets does this book hold?[/b]

Pick up the book, and there’s a hidden passageway in the bookshelf! It leads to the next mysterious room. 😈
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121044/dc8b391f4ffde435850e1042ef2d5ad9e33c2d5f.gif[/img]


[b]3. Open the fuse box for a surprise![/b]

Pick up the red wire—this looks like it could be assembled into something... Want to give it a try? 🤔
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121044/00d0757087da9a5d09efb5832a5b6611eff0d920.gif[/img]


[b]4. There’s a mirrored cabinet here! Open it and take a look![/b]

You’ll find a key! But which door does it open? 🔑
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121044/996f7e0cc882473dd56a8ee65b5fcacf5a4f064b.gif[/img]


[b]5. Oh my! How do you open this door?[/b]

Remove the door handle! Try attaching it to this door, and you might just find a surprise! 🚪
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121044/cc2acd5872a23298792365dfbd3b3e7f031f3f26.gif[/img]



[b]Enjoy the game![/b]

If you have any feedback, feel free to reach out to us anytime.
Thank you!

notes.title: Game Walkthrough Part 1
notes.notes:
[b]Hi, friends! [/b]

We've heard that some of you are getting stuck in the game, so we've put together a few tips to help you out. Check them out below!



[b]1. How to Enter the Mysterious Manor?[/b]

Open the mailbox to find the key, but beware of the surprise inside! 🦅
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121044/8e23d817339d2d01544ba403e7e5f6374fba5497.gif[/img]


[b]2. Where to Enter the Creepy Villa?[/b]

Unlock the basement door and begin your exploration from there!🔑
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121044/790187e3724bbdae870cdadf3b062cd32d9fdd7d.gif[/img]


[b]3. Help! How Do I Avoid That Terrifying Monster?![/b]

Quick, find a cabinet to hide in! But beware—in your hiding spot, you might not be alone. Watch out for a mysterious "companion" nearby! 👀
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121044/3467f1a0812ddf9f2152bc8170734dcae8e258df.gif[/img]


[b]4. Oh No! It's Back Again!![/b]

Whenever you pick up a puzzle piece, it's time to hide! Be cautious of the frequent flashes and eerie music that follows. 🧩
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121044/88fa22bf49a37ce53944649d1674ebfebcf0cdef.gif[/img]



[b]Enjoy the game! [/b]

If you have any feedback, feel free to reach out to us anytime. 
Thank you!
